tokens.name: indigo-50
tokens.usage: Oru Indigo 50 — page tint behind brand areas. Reach for `surface-brand` / `primary-soft` instead of using it directly.

tokens.name: indigo-100
tokens.usage: Oru Indigo 100 — raw scale step. Hover on soft brand surfaces.

tokens.name: indigo-200
tokens.usage: Oru Indigo 200 — raw scale step. Secondary chart series (via `chart-2`).

tokens.name: indigo-300
tokens.usage: Oru Indigo 300 — raw scale step. Brand text and focus ring in the dark theme (via `primary-text`, `focus`).

tokens.name: indigo-400
tokens.usage: Oru Indigo 400 — raw scale step. Chart series in the dark theme.

tokens.name: indigo-500
tokens.usage: Oru Indigo 500 — the brand's reference hue. Logo-adjacent accents only; never text on white (fails 4.5:1).

tokens.name: indigo-600
tokens.usage: Oru Indigo 600 — THE primary. Primary buttons, active nav, links (via `primary`, `primary-text`).

tokens.name: indigo-700
tokens.usage: Oru Indigo 700 — pressed / hover of primary (via `primary-hover`).

tokens.name: indigo-800
tokens.usage: Oru Indigo 800 — raw scale step. Deep accents, rarely needed.

tokens.name: indigo-900
tokens.usage: Oru Indigo 900 — Primary Deep. Reserved for marketing and illustration grounds.

tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Page background behind cards, in every app.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, sheets, nav bars, inputs. Text on it: `text`, `text-muted`.

tokens.name: surface-muted
tokens.usage: Inset areas: search fields, table headers, the excused/offline pill, quiet icon tiles.

tokens.name: surface-brand
tokens.usage: Tinted brand band: the school identity strip, selected rows, info cards that should feel 'ours'.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Hairline dividers between list rows and around cards. Decorative only — never the only edge of a control.

tokens.name: border-strong
tokens.usage: Edges of controls (inputs, checkboxes, secondary buttons). ≥3:1 on `surface`, `surface-muted`, `bg`.

tokens.name: text
tokens.usage: Primary text: names, titles, numbers, body copy. On `bg`, `surface`, `surface-muted`, `surface-brand`, `primary-soft`.

tokens.name: text-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: roll numbers, timestamps, hints, captions. Same grounds as `text`. Never lighter than this.

tokens.name: primary
tokens.usage: Fill of the ONE primary action on a screen (Take Attendance, Submit, Pay Fees). White text via `on-primary`. Schools in white-label Mode A override this token.

tokens.name: primary-hover
tokens.usage: Hover / pressed fill of `primary`.

tokens.name: on-primary
tokens.usage: Text and icons on `primary`, `primary-hover`, `success-solid`, `danger-solid`.

tokens.name: primary-text
tokens.usage: Links, 'View all', active tab label and icon, secondary-button text. On `surface`, `bg`, `primary-soft`, `surface-muted`.

tokens.name: primary-soft
tokens.usage: Background of the active nav item, secondary buttons, selected segment, brand icon tiles.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus ring: 2px solid outline, 2px offset. ≥3:1 on every surface.

tokens.name: success-fg
tokens.usage: Good news text + icon: Present, Synced, Paid, On schedule, upward trends. On `success-bg` and `surface`.

tokens.name: success-bg
tokens.usage: Soft fill behind `success-fg` (pills, icon tiles, banners).

tokens.name: success-solid
tokens.usage: Solid fill for the driver's Boarding tile and other large positive actions; text `on-primary`.

tokens.name: warning-fg
tokens.usage: Needs-attention text + icon: Late, Saved on device / changes pending, Pending approval, Due soon. On `warning-bg` and `surface`.

tokens.name: warning-bg
tokens.usage: Soft fill behind `warning-fg`.

tokens.name: danger-fg
tokens.usage: Problem text + icon: Absent, Sync failed, Overdue, Delayed bus, destructive links. On `danger-bg` and `surface`.

tokens.name: danger-bg
tokens.usage: Soft fill behind `danger-fg`; the Contact School tile.

tokens.name: danger-solid
tokens.usage: Solid fill for destructive confirm buttons and the driver's emergency action; text `on-primary`.

tokens.name: info-fg
tokens.usage: Neutral-informative text + icon: Leave, Syncing…, Review, announcements. On `info-bg` and `surface`.

tokens.name: info-bg
tokens.usage: Soft fill behind `info-fg`.

tokens.name: purple-fg
tokens.usage: Medical attendance status only. On `purple-bg` and `surface`.

tokens.name: purple-bg
tokens.usage: Soft fill behind `purple-fg`.

tokens.name: teal-fg
tokens.usage: Half Day attendance status only. On `teal-bg` and `surface`.

tokens.name: teal-bg
tokens.usage: Soft fill behind `teal-fg`.

tokens.name: chart-1
tokens.usage: Main data series (attendance bars, fee progress). Graphical, ≥3:1 on `surface`.

tokens.name: chart-2
tokens.usage: Comparison / remainder series (absent share, target). Always paired with a legend label.

tokens.name: app-erp
tokens.usage: ERP app icon and store art only (white mark, 11.4:1). Never product UI.

tokens.name: app-teacher
tokens.usage: Teacher app icon and store art only (white mark, 6.3:1). Never product UI.

tokens.name: app-staff
tokens.usage: Staff app icon and store art only (white mark, 5.4:1). Never product UI.

tokens.name: app-parent
tokens.usage: Parent app icon and store art only (white mark, 4.8:1). Warm on purpose. Never product UI.

tokens.name: app-driver
tokens.usage: Driver app icon and store art only — Ink #151838 mark (9.4:1), never white (1.8:1). Never product UI.

families.sans: "Noto Sans", "Noto Sans Devanagari", system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", Roboto, sans-serif

styles.name: display
styles.usage: The greeting at the top of every home screen and the principal dashboard. Once per screen.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Screen titles and the subject of a workflow (the class, the route, the child).

styles.name: subheading
styles.usage: The main line of a list row: a student, a task, a message sender.

styles.name: body-lg
styles.sample: Ananya showed great creativity in today's English class.
styles.usage: Default body text in all mobile apps. Never smaller on a phone.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Daily attendance trend across all grades
styles.usage: Default body text in the Web ERP, table cells, secondary lines in mobile rows.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Buttons, form labels, status pills, tab labels.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Timestamps, roll numbers, helper text. The smallest text in the system — nothing goes below 13px.

styles.name: stat
styles.usage: The headline number of a stat card (students, attendance %, fees). Tabular figures.

styles.name: stat-sm
styles.usage: Secondary numbers inside cards and the driver's ETA.

styles.name: action-xl
styles.usage: Driver app action tiles and other glance-and-tap labels.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-text gap inside pills and badges.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between a label and its control; between tight inline items.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Gap between list-row content; padding inside pills and small tiles.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Mobile screen side margin; card padding on mobile; gap between cards.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Card padding in the Web ERP.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gap between page sections; ERP page gutters.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Large section breaks; empty-state padding.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Top spacing of a page header on desktop.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Status pills, badges with text, checkboxes (6px drawn inside), small icon tiles.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, segmented controls, list rows that stand alone.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards and banners.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Driver action tiles, bottom sheets.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Avatars, count badges, the sync pill.

size.note: Control heights per density level (design_system_spec §3). Pick the density from the app, never mix two on one screen.

tokens.name: control-compact
tokens.usage: ERP Compact: controls in data grids, ledgers and student lists (32–36px band).

tokens.name: control-comfortable
tokens.usage: ERP Comfortable: dashboard, settings, forms (36–40px band).

tokens.name: control-touch
tokens.usage: Mobile Touch: minimum tap target in Teacher, Staff and Parent apps.

tokens.name: control-driver
tokens.usage: Driver Safety: minimum primary control in the Driver app during a route (56–72px band).

tokens.name: icon-sm
tokens.usage: Icons inside pills, badges and caption lines.

tokens.name: icon-md
tokens.usage: Icons in buttons, inputs, list rows and nav.

tokens.name: icon-lg
tokens.usage: Icons in icon tiles, bottom nav and empty states; 32px in driver tiles.

tokens.name: shadow-card
tokens.usage: Resting cards. Paired with a `border` hairline — the hairline does the work, the shadow only lifts.

tokens.name: shadow-raised
tokens.usage: Menus, dropdowns, bottom sheets, the sticky submit bar.
